searchText: Thank you so much! I will review the issues. However I might not be able to get started until April (preparing for the upcoming ETH Taipei！). I’ll let the team know when I begin working on some issue. <@892053833121923094> These are all tests from ethereum/tests (in pytest format already). We are regularly reviewing these tests and submit PRs to EEST with cleanup tests. So this PR is good tracker what is left to migrate / review. Line count / file count should only go down 🙂 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/1169 This is evmone coverage for EEST@EOF tests: https://app.codecov.io/gh/ethereum/evmone/tree/master/lib%2Fevmone?flags%5B0%5D=eof_execution_spec_tests shared with eest team, thanks so much 👍 Could we have a list of client devs working on eof for each client team? We're making a new role per person, this role gets tagged on the devnet-alert chat here ⁠https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1340943817653616742 so that everyone involved knows there's a bug in the client and gets daily hive updates. oh, I was expecting it to be even more 100%-ish. Some lines missed are unreachable, or irrelevant plumbing or unused "advanced/JITing" mode, but there are some gaps to identify and fill here and there. So my info on the call was not up-to-date. (note however, that you get a few % more if you turn `ethereum_tests` flag on as well). I also have a feeling some gaps are due to [7702-EXT*CALL interaction PR](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/1309) not in the 2.2.0 release yet. Should I write down some explainer to help navigate this report?
